SIGNALS.name: OpenAI Developers
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI Developers says eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can now claim up to $500 per month in API credits to build apps and agents.

SIGNALS.name: News from Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google introduces Gemini 4 Carbon from DeepMind, calling it its strongest model, with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon abilities for sustained agentic workflows.

SIGNALS.name: BusinessToday Malaysia
SIGNALS.summary: Cites The Information reporting that OpenAI plans to buy AI chips from Google, which could deepen ties between the two companies as AI compute demand grows.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Reports Anthropic extended its 40% government discount for Claude to every level of U.S. government under a new OneGov agreement with the GSA.

SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Google says Genie 4 builds on the Gemini family, with Gemini Omni grounding simulations in real-world appearance and behavior, and adds live steering by text prompts.

SIGNALS.name: Defence Chronicle India
SIGNALS.summary: Reports that HQ Integrated Defence Staff signed an MoU with Sarvam AI for AI applications across the Army, Navy and Air Force, focused on secure, sovereign AI.

SIGNALS.name: levent
SIGNALS.summary: Levent Alpöge says an internal Claude research model found the core algorithm for a new paper on 16 October, using 14M output tokens with no human input, and Anthropic researchers helped polish the paper.

SIGNALS.name: Dan Roberts
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI's Dan Roberts announces three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science and physics, covering harmonic analysis, complexity theory and quantum field theory.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra, a model for fast computer use at a lower price that understands the screen and takes actions across apps.
